name: Vega de San Mateo (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, orange at the hoist and blue at the fly.
history: The flag used by the municipality shows orange and blue on two right triangles arranged diagonally, orange towards the hoist and blue towards the fly; the design is unofficial, adopting the colours worn by the municipality's Canarian wrestling team since the 1970s.
